snippet.title: McDonald's 1999 PC Game - Mission To McDonaldland
snippet.description:
Something really random today for you guys, this game i had back in 1999 when they started to sell it in McDonald's around New Zealand and Australia. I found this in a charity shop for $2 and just had to grab it and check it out so here we go!


Cover & Cd Art: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/18j79Cg-12SwuvBrwek0tnmRhanXqPYIO?usp=sharing

ISO Download Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B9D4zSb5UAZVVlcyU0RBa0JJbTA/view?usp=sharing&resourcekey=0-L2ElZh5JAmEKGz1NnIFpDQ
